g.text: PARTIAL composition | Reported sum = 36.872 wt% | Unreported balance: unassigned
Bars show the listed assignments, not a complete alloy recipe. The right panel repeats minor constituents on a different scale.
Error bars: reported expanded U at 95% confidence. Each reported k is retained; reference uncertainties may omit contributions.
Information uncertainty is UNKNOWN; no error bar is drawn. No Iron remainder or combined uncertainty is inferred.
